new_art_target.frame_count: Chosen after contact/face/loop review, not a fixed 24–32 requirement
new_art_target.quality_rationale: For a 64px stride, 64 unique phase samples keep each average stance hold to 1 logical px at 22px/s; 96 gives 0.667px and 128 gives 0.5px. Actual max phase gap, not the count alone, must satisfy the bound.
new_art_target.camera: Same right-facing side/profile as current Walk; no front or three-quarter camera changes
new_art_target.identity: Preserve existing head silhouette, face/eye scale and position, orange cap and back stripes, cream muzzle/chest/paws; avoid head redraw drift
new_art_target.root: Fixed support root; no painted whole-body translation duplicating Box2D travel
new_art_target.contact_curve_rule: For each continuous contact, local_x(p2)-local_x(p1) = -stride_logical / reference_scale * (p2-p1). Source front-leg trajectory implied by old verified stance: local_x(p)=256-128.581818*(p-.225). Treat phases and stride as candidate constraints, then recalibrate using accepted new art.
new_art_target.swing_curve_rule: Release heel, roll onto toes, lift paw with flexed wrist/hock, bring it forward clear of floor, extend down, contact toes then flatten sole. Near/far pairs are offset, not simultaneously lifted.

critical_interval_3_4_5.needs: Continuous backward stance foot travel and progressive shoulder/elbow wrist/hock changes while torso/head stay fixed. Do not bridge with alpha dissolve or a whole-figure affine warp.

new_art_target.loop_boundary: One continuous phase cycle with frame0 only once. Match root, paw velocity and contact labels across last->first; do not append a duplicate frame0.
new_art_target.registration: Keep source cell aspect ratio and normalized head/torso/root placement for both Cream and Tuxedo. Use one common referenceHeight; cell resizing is permitted only as one shared authored resolution choice, never pose-by-pose fitting.

acceptance.unique_art: Each credited new sample must contain newly rendered limb/foot articulation; identical head/body pixels may be reused to preserve identity. Duplicates, whole-image affine changes and translucent composites do not count.
acceptance.face_body_registration: Stable head and torso apparent scale with no camera/viewpoint changes; investigate shifts exceeding 1 logical pixel at adult reference.
acceptance.contact_and_air: No high-alpha sole below ground. Swing paws may be above it. Do not ground-align airborne feet.
acceptance.alpha: True RGBA alpha, clear cell margins, ears/tail/paws wholly contained; alpha<=16 noise is already discarded by loader, never use black/white chroma key.
acceptance.comparison: Before8 and new accepted poses at same logical110px reference, 22px/s, same64px initial stride and same physics state. If recalibrating stride, report old/new stride explicitly.
acceptance.timing: Derive each distance weight from measured contact position changes and pose sequence. Uniform only if newly authored phases actually are uniform. Report max hold duration, not just frame count.

integration.importer: tools/import_care_sprites.py schema2 supports frame_count1..256, explicit rect/anchor, independent stride_pixels, standing_frame, and intro/loop/outro step lists.
integration.sequences: src/cat_sprite_sequence.hpp supports256 source frames and512 steps; Walk/Run step ms are distance weights.
integration.coat: AuthoredCharacter(8)=0. Both characters share one descriptor/program/root; src/cat_coat.hpp transforms prewarmed pixels only and preserves alpha. Walk head region is normalized(.73,.39,.23,.29).
integration.budgets: Loader counts both coat pixel arrays against48Mi pixels. 64/96 frames at314² fit current aggregate budget;128 at314² marginally exceeds it, while128 at256² fits. Actual encoded sheet <=32MiB and32Mi pixels, maxside16384.
